_comment: EMS internal product IDs and form labels. Keys starting with _ are comments. Point EMS_FORM_DATA in .env at a different copy of this file for another EMS server.
_highest-product-key-serial-number-custo: This customer's Ref ID 1 contains the highest used product key serial number. Will be excluded from being able to have entitlements

lease-expiry-range._comment: Inclusive calendar months after the entitlement start date.

product-options._comment: The form enforces at least one of these.

optional-products._comment: Any or none of these can be selected.

version._comment: Only one can be selected. The option with an empty product-id is the default and adds no product.

lease._comment: Selecting this shows the lease expiry date and writes the base product Expiry Date segment.
